name: Yalla Shoot

intro.Ads: Banners, native ads, full-screen and rewarded ads.
intro.Privacy: Trackers and permissions. They change nothing you see.

summary: Remove the ads from the live football scores app and keep its Firebase tracking off, without an account.

android.note: Yalla Shoot 6.0.15 needs Android 7 (minSdk 24), and its APK has x86_64 libraries, so the emulator needs no arm translation. The release tries an older supported version, the newest stable one and the next one; a pull request an older one and the newest stable.

versions.phone_test: open today's matches, a match page and the news on a phone: the emulator test only starts the app.
